fusions.name: Shed Spores
fusions.desc: Shakes spores loose on every enemy within 2.5 tiles: each one takes a puff that deals 3 damage and is [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Fruiting Body
fusions.desc: A blow that deals 18 damage and bursts every affliction you have on the target, uses them up, and deals 60% more damage for each one. It leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Moss Takes Over
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to you for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Grows on Anything
fusions.desc: Your afflictions take hold on enemies that are immune to them. You have 8% poison resistance.
